post.description:
After `search_foods` or `search_foods_by_nutrient` returned an FDC id, or when the user pastes a food-details URL.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

fdc_id.description:
FoodData Central id (e.g. 328637 Cheese, cheddar; 2705709 Survey cheddar; 2672832 a Branded cracker). Give either fdc_id or url.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

url.description: A food page URL such as https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/328637/nutrients.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The complete FoodData Central record of one food by FDC id (GET /portal-data/external/{fdcId}, the web portal's own backend; also accepts a pasted fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-details/{fdcId}/... URL). Returns identity (data type, NDB number / FNDDS food code / GTIN-UPC, category, publication and update dates), every nutrient with its per-100 g value, unit, data points, min/max/median, derivation and source, portions with gram weights, nutrient conversion factors, ontology attributes (FoodOn, NCBI taxon), the Survey input foods, and for Branded foods the brand, ingredients, serving size and label nutrients. Section-header rows without a value (e.g. 'Proximates') and the per-sample laboratory analysis details of Foundation foods are not returned; `analyses` counts them. Missing optional fields are null. An unknown id is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attributes` | object[] | Distinct (name, value) food attributes: FoodOn / NCBI taxon ontology links, WWEIA category, Branded change notes. |
| `brand` | object | Branded foods only; null for other data types. |
| `conversion_factors` | object[] |  |
| `data_type` | string | Foundation, SR Legacy, Survey (FNDDS), Branded or Experimental, as the portal's foodType. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `fdc_id` | number |  |
| `food_category` | object | Foundation / SR Legacy food group, Survey WWEIA category, or the Branded GPC category group (description only). |
| `food_class` | string | The portal's foodClass (FinalFood, Survey, Branded). |
| `food_code` | string | Survey (FNDDS) food code; null for other data types (the portal's literal 'null' string is mapped to null). |
| `gtin_upc` | string |  |
| `is_historical_reference` | boolean |  |
| `label_nutrients` | object | Branded foods only: the Nutrition Facts label values per serving keyed by the portal's label names (calories, fat, saturatedFat, transFat, cholesterol, sodium, carbohydrates, fiber, sugars, protein, calcium, iron, ...); passed through as the portal names them. Null for other data types. |
| `last_updated` | string | M/D/YYYY as the portal formats it. |
| `ndb_number` | string |  |
| `nutrient_count` | number |  |
| `nutrients` | object[] |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `portions` | object[] |  |
| `published_date` | string | Publication date as the portal formats it (M/D/YYYY); null where the record carries none (Foundation, SR Legacy). |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `survey` | object | Survey (FNDDS) foods only: the WWEIA cycle dates and the SR foods the recipe is built from. |
| `total_refuse` | number |  |
| `url` | string |  |

post.description:
To find a nutrient id or unit before `search_foods_by_nutrient`, or to see which nutrients the database tracks at all.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the nutrient name, short name or number. Omitted returns all nutrients.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The FoodData Central nutrient reference list (GET /portal-data/external/fullNutrientList): every nutrient the database can report (267 entries) with its id (the key `search_foods_by_nutrient` takes), nutrient number (the public API's key), name, unit, display rank and indent level. An optional case-insensitive text filter matches the name, short name or number, so 'biotin', 'chromium', 'molybdenum' or an amino acid name return just those rows; no match is a valid empty list.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description:
Start here to find FDC ids by name, brand, UPC or to enumerate a data type; then call `get_food` for the full record.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

data_types.description: Data types to include, as FoodData Central names them. Default: all five.

include_nutrients.description: Include each result's per-100 g nutrient values (the portal returns them with every result; a Branded page can be large).

page.description:
1-based page of 50 results.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100000; default 1.

query.description:
Search text (food description words, a brand owner, an ingredient or a GTIN/UPC). Empty or omitted lists every food of the selected data types.

Provider reference: default "".

require_all_words.description: Match only foods containing every word of the query (the portal's default); false matches any word.

sort_by.description:
Sort column: food description (default) or publication date.

Provider reference: allowed values ["description", "publishedDate"]; default "description".

sort_direction.description:
sort_direction

Provider reference: allowed values ["asc", "desc"]; default "asc".

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Search FoodData Central foods (POST /portal-data/external/search, the web portal's own backend) by free text across one or more data types (Foundation, SR Legacy, Survey (FNDDS), Branded, Experimental). The text matches descriptions, brand owners, ingredients and GTIN/UPC codes; an empty query lists every food of the selected data types (e.g. all ~400 Foundation foods), sorted by description or published date. 50 results per page; `total_hits` and `counts_by_data_type` report how many foods match in every data type regardless of the filter. Each result carries the FDC id that `get_food` takes, the data-type specific identifier (NDB number, FNDDS food code or GTIN/UPC), brand and category fields where the data type has them (null otherwise) and, when `include_nutrients` is true, the per-100 g nutrient values the portal returns with every result. A page past the last page is `not_found`; a query with no match is a valid empty result.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `counts_by_data_type` | object | The portal's dataType aggregation: matching foods per data type across all data types, keyed by the FoodData Central data-type name. |
| `data_types` | string[] |  |
| `foods` | object[] |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number | Results per page as the portal fixes it (50). |
| `query` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total_hits` | number | Matching foods within the selected data types. |
| `total_pages` | number |  |

post.description:
To find which foods have data for a specific nutrient, or the richest sources of it; `get_food` then gives the full record.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

data_types.description: Restrict to these data types; omitted means all.

nutrient_id.description:
FoodData Central nutrient id (from `list_nutrients`): 1176 Biotin, 1096 Chromium, 1102 Molybdenum, 1100 Iodine, 1210 Tryptophan, 1003 Protein, 1051 Water.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

page.description:
page

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100000; default 1.

page_size.description:
page_size

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

sort_direction.description:
Order by nutrient value; the portal's default is descending (richest first).

Provider reference: allowed values ["asc", "desc"]; default "desc".

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Nutrient-centric search (POST /portal-data/external/nutrientList/search, the web portal's 'Nutrient search'): the foods that carry a value for one nutrient, ranked by amount per 100 g, optionally restricted to data types. Takes the nutrient id from `list_nutrients` (e.g. 1176 Biotin, 1096 Chromium, 1102 Molybdenum, 1100 Iodine, 1210 Tryptophan, 1051 Water), not the nutrient number. Returns the nutrient's reference identity and unit, the matching foods with their FDC id, data type, native identifier (NDB number, UPC/GTIN or food code), value and the portal's household measure, plus `counts_by_data_type` (matching foods per data type across all types). This is the tool for coverage questions: which Foundation or SR Legacy foods have biotin at all. An unknown nutrient id is `not_found`; a nutrient no food carries is a valid empty result. 25 results per page by default (1-100).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `counts_by_data_type` | object | The portal's resultCounts: foods carrying this nutrient per data type, keyed by the FoodData Central data-type name (reported for every data type regardless of the filter). |
| `data_types` | string[] |  |
| `nutrient` | object |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number |  |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total_hits` | number |  |
| `total_pages` | number |  |
